_comment: Live smoke plan for the cnc-lab instance (5 XRd devices, SR-PCE provider cml-pce, credential profile cml-xrd). Read phase is side-effect free. Write phase creates smoke-* objects and removes them again (create -> verify -> delete), leaving the platform as found. Data Gateway steps target the embedded gateway: mapping 'remove' really unmaps but the embedded pool re-maps within ~2 s, and 'add' immediately after a remove succeeds (verified), so the write phase leaves mappings as found. NSO steps act on P2 only (check-sync, sync-from) and prove the zero-match and wildcard guards; sync-to and the inventory-wide sync are not run.
